name: Verdigris Siphon
core_rationale: Eastern patinated-copper aqueduct terrace of Continent 02 where Krono's alchemical coolant pipes drain into turquoise mineral basins and water-driven gear-looms.
local_conflict: Oxidized siphon-constructs and brine-striders are clogging the main coolant sluices, threatening to overheat the eastern Mainspring Caldera vents.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Pressurized turquoise coolant cascades over the northern Teal Spillway; the Lock-Keepers Guild has bolted the weir gate until the monsoon sluices subside.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Dyers and alchemists whisper that the northern Teal Spillway drops into an uncharted sea-cliff cavern where pre-war clockwork submarines are dry-docked.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Tiered turquoise-patinated copper aqueduct arches spilling shimmering coolant waterfalls across golden grass steppes.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Where does the northern Teal Spillway canal empty once the weir gate is raised?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-krono-brass-titan and connects West via the Siphon Aqueduct to Escapement Anvil in Mainspring Caldera.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Turquoise-patinated copper aqueducts and water-driven clockwork looms above mineral pools.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Uses 14.0 meter aqueduct causeways, 0.15 meter sluice steps, and 0.60 meter dye-vat counters for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Orthogonal 2x2 grid with Siphon Sluiceway [0,1], Patina Lock Town [1,1], Mercury Reservoir Dungeon [1,1, floor -1], and Teal Spillway [1,0] (Fog of Lore) plus Level 26 to 34 construct/insect spawns.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Seals the northern Teal Spillway frontier behind a fog_of_lore portal and Lock-Keepers Guild weir rumor.
